description: Sample hybrid bolt responses. Quantities that can be recorded include axial-displacement, axial-strain, cable-state, dowel-displacement, dowel-force, dowel-state, dowel-strain, force, grout-slip, grout-stress, stress, dowel-id, element-id, node-id. If a hybrid bolt is created using the sel hybrid create command, then the nodes of each element so created will be ordered such that the overall bolt direction goes from the first point to the second point (i.e., the nodal connectivity of each element will be ordered such that the direction from end-1 to end-2 corresponds with the direction from the begin point to the end point).

keywords.name: axial-displacement
keywords.description: Get axial displacement in the element. (The 7.0 manual leaves this entry blank; wording follows the sibling entries.)

keywords.name: axial-strain
keywords.description: Get axial strain in the element. (The 7.0 manual leaves this entry blank; wording follows the sibling entries.)

keywords.name: cable-state
keywords.description: Get tensile yield state of the element. Value {0, 1, 2} denotes never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively.

keywords.name: dowel-displacement
keywords.description: Get shear displacement of the dowel. (The 7.0 manual leaves this entry blank; wording follows the sibling entries.)

keywords.name: dowel-force
keywords.description: Get shear force in the dowel. (The 7.0 manual leaves this entry blank; wording follows the sibling entries.)

keywords.name: dowel-state
keywords.description: Get the yield state of the dowel. (The 7.0 manual leaves this entry blank; wording follows the sibling entries.)

keywords.name: dowel-strain
keywords.description: Get shear strain in the dowel. (The 7.0 manual leaves this entry blank; wording follows the sibling entries.)

keywords.name: force
keywords.description: Get average axial force in the element (positive: tension; negative: compression).

keywords.name: grout-slip
keywords.description: Get slip in grout (shear coupling spring) at end of the element. Sign convention is +/- with respect to the average axial direction of hybrid.

keywords.name: grout-stress
keywords.description: Get stress in grout (shear coupling spring) at end of the element. Sign convention is +/- with respect to the average axial direction of hybrid.

keywords.name: stress
keywords.description: Get axial stress in the element (positive: tension; negative: compression).

keywords.name: position
keywords.description: The particular element is identified by ( v ) coordinates (the nearest element is taken). If this keyword is used, element-id , node-id , and dowel-id should not be used.

keywords.name: dowel-id
keywords.description: The particular element is identified by the dowel ID of an associated dowel. If this keyword is used, position , element-id , and node-id should not be used.

keywords.name: element-id
keywords.description: The particular element is identified by the element ID number. If this keyword is used, position , dowel-id , and node-id should not be used.

keywords.name: node-id
keywords.description: The particular element is identified by the node ID of one of its associated nodes. If this keyword is used, position , dowel-id , and element-id should not be used.

keywords.name: name
keywords.description: Listed by 'sel hybrid history ?' on 3DEC 7.00 but not on the 7.0 manual page; what it does is not documented.
